field_principles.action_entropy: Shannon entropy over dry-run action/coordinate choices as a bare float.
field_principles.already_reproduced: must be false for any ready artifact.
field_principles.arc_levelup_candidate_ready: bare bool true only when registry and Exp5508-pattern gates pass and the diversity metrics meet threshold.
field_principles.candidate_generator_changes: non-empty list naming live-path generation changes such as repeated-coordinate suppression, target rotation, action entropy gating, or salience coverage.
field_principles.exp5508_pattern_reused: must be false; Exp5508's repeated ACTION6 coordinate loop cannot be reused.
field_principles.honest_verdict: one-line verdict starting complete: or blocked: without claiming a solve.
field_principles.no_credit_probe_attempts: bare int count of no-credit dry-run choices measured before the live attempt.
field_principles.registry_precheck_done: bare bool proving ops/arc_solve_registry.yaml was checked before target selection.
field_principles.repeated_coordinate_rate: fraction of dry-run consecutive coordinate choices that repeat a prior coordinate, as a bare float.
field_principles.salience_coverage_rate: fraction of dry-run choices covering distinct salience candidates, as a bare float.
field_principles.selected_game: one registry-safe game id selected for the next live level-up attempt, or empty string when blocked.
field_principles.selected_level: next unreproduced target level as a string or bare int; it must be strictly deeper than the registry depth.
